subject.title: [BUG] exec tool: aborted run wedges subsequent exec calls in same session (regression from PR #94412)

question: Should #102006 be folded into the run-lifecycle reliability stack, or kept as a separate exec/session cleanup bug until exact coverage is proven?
rationale: The open lifecycle and diagnostic PRs target adjacent stale-run and blocked-tool states, but the issue now has a broader cron-triggered reproduction and no merged PR explicitly covering this exact v2026.6.11 wedge.

options.title: Require explicit coverage proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require #102160, #90750, or a follow-up to show a current-main or branch proof where a later same-session exec/cron/web_search call recovers after the reported stale state.

options.title: Split into a focused exec bug
options.body: Route a separate narrow repro and fix if maintainers decide the lifecycle stack does not own the exec process/session settlement path.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle stack now
options.body: Treat #101863/#102160 as the canonical owner and close only after maintainers accept that this issue needs no separate tracking.

recommendation.title: Require explicit coverage proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require #102160, #90750, or a follow-up to show a current-main or branch proof where a later same-session exec/cron/web_search call recovers after the reported stale state.
